name: Bayarque (Spain)
description: Horizontal stripes of blue, yellow, white, yellow and blue with the outer blue stripes of triple width, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bayarque (a crescent on blue between yellow figures above waves).
history: Bayarque adopted its arms officially on 4 July 1996 and its flag on 7 April 2011; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 3:2 divided into three equal horizontal stripes, the upper and lower blue and the central one divided into three equal stripes yellow, white and yellow.

features.role: Bayarque arms — crescent and figures above waves
